ei.title: The Myth of the Tongue Map
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: The tongue was mapped into separate areas where certain tastes were registered: sweetness at the tip, sourness on the sides, and bitterness at the back of the mouth. Research in the 1980s and 1990s, however, demonstrated that the "tongue map" explanation of how we taste was, in fact, totally wrong. As it turns out, the map was a misinterpretation and mistranslation of research conducted in Germany at the turn of the twentieth century. Today, leading taste researchers believe that taste buds are not grouped according to specialty. Sweetness, saltiness, bitterness, and sourness can be tasted everywhere in the mouth, although they may be perceived at a little different intensities at different sites. Moreover, the mechanism at work is not place, but time. It's not that you taste sweetness at the tip of your tongue, but rather that you register that perception first.

✅ ② totally correct → totally wrong: 원문은 'was, in fact, totally wrong(사실 완전히 틀렸다)'이나 'totally correct(완전히 옳은)'로 바뀌어 반증 내용과 정반대 ←정답
❌ ③ As it turns out...: 원문 일치
❌ ④ Today, leading taste researchers...: 원문 일치
det.tip: 원문은 totally wrong(완전히 틀린). correct로 바뀌면 반증 내용과 모순

questions.passage: The tongue was mapped into separate areas where certain tastes were registered: sweetness at the tip, sourness on the sides, and bitterness at the back of the mouth. Research in the 1980s and 1990s, however, demonstrated that the "tongue map" explanation of how we taste was, in fact, totally wrong. As it turns out, the map was a misinterpretation and mistranslation of research conducted in Germany at the turn of the twentieth century. Today, leading taste researchers believe that taste buds are not grouped according to specialty. Sweetness, saltiness, bitterness, and sourness can be tasted everywhere in the mouth, although they may be perceived at a little different intensities at different sites. Moreover, the mechanism at work is not place, but time. It's not that you taste sweetness at the tip of your tongue, but rather that you register that perception first.
questions.stem: 위 글에 따르면, 네 가지 맛이 부위에 따라 어떻게 다르게 느껴질 수 있는지, 그 '서로 다른 강도'를 나타내는 표현을 본문에서 찾아 영어 2단어로 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: different intensities(서로 다른 강도): 부위마다 맛이 느껴지는 정도의 차이
det.analysis: 본문 S5 'they may be perceived at a little different intensities at different sites'에서 부위마다 맛이 느껴지는 정도의 차이를 나타내는 표현은 different intensities(서로 다른 강도)이다.
det.tip: perceived at a little different intensities = 조금 다른 강도로 인지됨
